user.title: Connect your Zehnder ventilation unit
user.description: Enable Modbus TCP on the ComfoConnect PRO first. Select the connected ventilation model; the gateway cannot identify the exact Q-series model over this interface.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Update the connection to the same ventilation unit. Existing entities and automations are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the gateway. Check its address, TCP port, unit ID and Modbus TCP mode. Another integration may be using conflicting connection settings.
error.wrong_device: The gateway reports that the ventilation unit is not a compatible ComfoAir Q.
error.incompatible_version: The gateway reports an incompatible ComfoAir Q firmware version. Check the device firmware.
error.no_ventilation_unit: The gateway cannot detect a ventilation unit. Check the ComfoNet connection and commissioning.
error.unknown_connection_state: The gateway returned an unknown connection status. Check its configuration and firmware.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid hostname or IP address, an integer TCP port (1–65535), unit ID (1–247) and supported model.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while checking the gateway. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This gateway endpoint and unit ID are already configured.

init.title: Polling options
init.description: Choose how often to refresh device state over Modbus. The integration reloads automatically when the interval changes.

data_description.scan_interval: Time between polls in whole seconds (minimum 5).

error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole number of seconds, 5 or greater.

write_failed.message: The gateway did not confirm the write. Check the device state before retrying the command.
